limitations.text: There is no complete federal feed of terminations, suspensions, appeals, settlements, and reinstatements. The financial detector covers only the registered accounts shown above, and sourced-event discovery covers only registered authoritative sources.
limitations.title: Incomplete discovery

limitations.text: Transaction amounts and agency prose do not establish why an action occurred beyond a reason explicitly attributed to a source.
limitations.title: No motive inference

limitations.text: The sentinel cannot determine whether an action is lawful, final, or likely to survive appeal.
limitations.title: No legal judgment

limitations.text: Announced affected value, prior obligations, posted deobligations, eliminated future funding, and later restorations are separate measures and may not reconcile.
limitations.title: Amounts are not interchangeable

limitations.text: A portfolio announcement without award identifiers cannot be completely joined to award-level records without another authoritative source.
limitations.title: Award mapping can be partial

limitations.text: Thresholds can prioritize unusual activity but cannot distinguish ordinary amendments, closeout, corrections, partial reductions, and terminations.
limitations.title: Routine versus extraordinary remains unresolved

limitations.text: Registered public pages can be monitored, but immediate or complete litigation coverage may require a paid or access-controlled service.
limitations.title: No comprehensive real-time docket monitoring

limitations.text: Archiving an authoritative source and reporting what it says does not independently verify every factual claim in that source.
limitations.title: Sources are attributed, not independently proven

limitations.text: Software can assemble evidence and propose a bounded finding; no human or agent is assigned a queue or deadline.
limitations.title: Review is optional judgment
